text: Here is something worth knowing: houses there had flat roofs of packed clay over reeds and beams, with a stairway up the outside wall.
You could dig through one with your hands in a few minutes — and patch it in a day.
Which is exactly what they did.
Four men on a stranger's roof, tearing through the clay, coughing in the dust, grinning at each other like men doing something magnificent and slightly insane.
